title: Kiritani Haruka — Behind The Surprise〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for that explanation.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
You're more than welcome.
I'll need some time to process your papers for switching over to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I've submitted all the papers they need for now, so I suppose all I can do now is wait for my teacher to let me know...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I'll head home for the day and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh? A message...? From Saki...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<Haruka, are you free after school?!
There's something reeaally important I need to ask you!!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Something really important...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I just thought a second ago that we need to throw a “Good Luck Minori and Haruka” party!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A party for us...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My plan for later today was to work on stream ideas, but we're in no rush so...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<That sounds fun.
I'm free today and actually still at school.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <You are?! Then, let's talk about it in our classroom♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, we're here...
Can you tell us what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll cut to the chase!
We're gonna throw a “Good Luck Minori and Haruka” party!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Good Luck Minori and Haruka”...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing you heard about us going credit-based.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I wasn't all that surprised.
I mean, we've known for a while that she might make the switch at any moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, she said you saw her carrying the papers...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, it's nice that you wanna throw a party for them. But what did you have in mind exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We're gonna think of that right now!
So, everyone other than Haruka, come join me for a strategy meeting♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. So it's a surprise party?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup! So get ready!
You and Minori are gonna be totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, don't you have work today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do, but I'm gonna stay to brainstorm until the last minute and then sprint over at full speed!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After my shift, I'll grab Minori and bring her over to wherever we're going!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hang on. What's Kiritani supposed to do during that time...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My original plan was to head home and work on ideas for our stream. I'll just do that here instead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll let you know once we figure out what time we're gonna meet and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much...
Especially you, Saki. I'm sure Minori's going to really enjoy this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you all noticed, but Minori thought long and hard about whether or not to switch over to the credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She was worried that some gaps would begin to form between you and her after becoming so close...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right, since we won't get to see each other every day anymore...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I totally get how she feels...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But our friendship's a lot stronger than she realizes! We're not gonna drift apart that easily!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I swear that you, Minori and us are BFFs all the way, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That was a pretty nice thing to say.
The “BFFs” bit makes it sound like you're not taking this seriously, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! No, I'm being totally serious!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Saki, everyone...
Thank you all so much...)
